proof_groups.proof_strategy: Reuse the established proof structure with Import DLL and unqualified DLL names: first prove the four-way entry decomposition by sentinel/member and nil/cons splits; then reconstruct store_dll for the four return cases; finally discharge the sentinel/member dispatch wands. Use payload_first_split__payload_insert_after, dllseg_split, dllseg_concat, and store_dll_member_not_sentinel__insert_after_payload. No generated statement or seed declaration needs modification.

space_plan.entry: Unfold store_dll and occupy_dll_node; split the member dllseg at the first anchor occurrence.
space_plan.returns: Unfold store_dll and rebuild the circular list, using dllseg_concat for the two member cases.
space_plan.dispatch: Frame the existing resources and use sepcon adjunction to consume the dispatch result.

pure_plan.entry: Construct sentinel or first-occurrence payload relations from the anchor case split.
pure_plan.returns: Reuse the generated PreH payload relation after substituting the branch list equation.
pure_plan.dispatch: Eliminate the impossible dispatch branch using anchor equality or member<>head.

premise_discharge.payload_split: payload_first_split__payload_insert_after from the entry membership hypothesis
premise_discharge.segment_endpoints: store_dll/dllseg existential structure and branch equalities

proof_groups.grouping_reason: The witnesses belong to one function and one model, share the same payload and segment facts, and total 7 <= max_witnesses_per_group 12. Keeping them together minimizes worker spawns and lets one worker carry the entry split directly into the return and dispatch proof scripts.
